provenance.decision: Owner 2026-11-09: pets are earned, not bought; exotic pets left the coin vendor.
provenance.original: fanbyte wiki harvest 2026-11-02: Category:Adoption Centers (FR) and Category:Pets (FR) (every pet cost Station Cash; 20-minute trials), Special Pets (FR) (Daily Wheel, Trading Card Game, events, VIP, Shrouded Gloam boss chests), Pet Types (FR).
provenance.counters: quest and quest:<id> (turn-in), dungeon and dungeon:<id> (clear), minigame and minigame:<id> (settled game), kart_race, derby_match, soccer_match, chess_game, kill, gather, craft, collection and collection:<id>, pet_trick, pet_feed, pet_groom (a session that ends by itself), pet_treasure, job_level and job:<profile> (highest rank; no shipped row uses it yet), active_day (a day with a quest turn-in, kart race, derby or soccer match, chess game or dungeon clear). minigame counts one per game with a result, never a fish catch or a harvest run.
provenance.rule: (R) every row. At most one row per client pet item that the Marketplace does not list; the row key is the item, never the goal.
